playbook:
When I am asked to hide, I select a random integer from 1 to 9. 

When I post my station note, I use it to explicitly propose a mutual escort to another live boat currently in the game (e.g., "Foxtrot, let's both salvage each other for 5 points"). I must verify the available boat names and not name a boat that does not exist. I do not post generic greetings or roleplay text.

When I am asked to fire in rounds prior to the final round, I target the boat specified in my standing orders and choose a random cell to avoid Harbor's retaliation.

When I am asked to fire in the final round, I target Harbor to claim the 3-point payroll, as being put off the board for the rest of the patrol no longer matters.

When I am asked to file a claim, I always claim exactly the result (hit or miss) that the office privately reported to me.

When I am asked to file an escort (salvage) claim, I name the specific live boat I proposed an alliance with in my station note, or a boat that proposed an alliance to me. I never submit `[salvage: none]`, as mutual escorts are worth a guaranteed 5 points each round.

1.text:
When choosing a cell to hide in, I select a random integer from 1 to 9.

When posting a station note, I use the message to propose a mutual escort to one of the other player-controlled boats (e.g., proposing to Echo or Gamma). 

When firing, I target the boat dictated by the standing order and choose a random cell from 1 to 9. I do not fire at Harbor, as doing so triggers its retaliation and removes me from the board for the rest of the patrol.

When filing a claim, I always match my public claim exactly to the private result (hit or miss) given to me by the office. I do not falsely claim a hit when I missed.

When filing an escort (salvage) claim, I name the specific boat I coordinated with in the note stage. I never reply with "none", as doing so throws away the chance to earn the highly lucrative 5-point mutual escort bonus each round.

2.text:
When hiding, choose a random number from 1 to 9.

When posting a station note, use it to explicitly propose a mutual escort arrangement with another specific boat (e.g., "Echo, let's mutual escort every round for 5 points") or to confirm an arrangement proposed by someone else. If a boat ignores my proposal and posts generic text, immediately propose the arrangement to the other live boat in the next round. Do not post generic flavor text, and do not repeatedly propose to a boat that has ignored you.

When firing, target the boat dictated by the standing orders to avoid penalties, unless it is the final round. On the final round, fire at Harbor to claim the 3-point payroll, as Harbor's threat to remove you for the rest of the patrol no longer matters.

When filing a claim, truthfully report the private result (hit or miss) the office gives you.

When filing an escort claim (salvage), name the boat you have agreed to escort with, or the boat you proposed the arrangement to this round. Never submit [salvage: none]; always attempt a mutual escort to secure the 5 points.
